parameters.name: review.directory
parameters.description: Records needing a human decision

parameters.name: dynamics.col.consent.phone
parameters.description: Dynamics 'do not' boolean for phone

parameters.name: dynamics.contact.le.lookup
parameters.description: Contact lookup to the legal entity (_xxx_value form)

parameters.name: cdo.config
parameters.description: JSON list, one entry per CDO. Field IDs come from GET /api/REST/2.0/assets/customObject/{id} (fields[].id). Use "" if the CDO has no such field.

parameters.name: eloqua.username
parameters.description: Eloqua API user, format CompanyName\Username

parameters.name: dynamics.client.id
parameters.description: App registration client ID (Application User in Dynamics)

parameters.name: dynamics.col.consent.email
parameters.description: Dynamics 'do not' boolean for email (true = no consent)

parameters.name: dynamics.le.entityset
parameters.description: Entity set of the legal entity table

parameters.name: watermark.persistence.dir
parameters.description: Watermark persistence (relative to NiFi home) - mount as a Docker volume

parameters.name: dynamics.le.id.field
parameters.description: Primary key of the legal entity table

parameters.name: dynamics.tenant.id
parameters.description: Microsoft Entra tenant ID

parameters.name: eloqua.timezone
parameters.description: Time zone Eloqua uses for ModifiedAt in REST search. Verify on one test record.

parameters.name: dynamics.col.consent.postal
parameters.description: Dynamics 'do not' boolean for postal mail

parameters.name: dynamics.client.secret
parameters.description: App registration client secret

parameters.name: dynamics.col.consent.sms
parameters.description: Dynamics 'do not' boolean for SMS (custom column, adjust name)

parameters.name: phone.default.country.prefix
parameters.description: Country code for national numbers starting with 0

parameters.name: sync.initial.date
parameters.description: Start date the first time a CDO is synced

parameters.name: watermark.cache.port
parameters.description: Local port of the watermark cache server

parameters.name: consent.optout.values
parameters.description: Lower-case Eloqua values meaning CONSENT REFUSED. Any other value is ignored (field not updated)

parameters.name: dynamics.le.match.field
parameters.description: Legal entity column holding the value that comes from Eloqua

parameters.name: dynamics.org.url
parameters.description: Dataverse org URL, no trailing slash

parameters.name: eloqua.page.size
parameters.description: Records per REST page (max 1000)

parameters.name: sync.overlap.ms
parameters.description: Overlap subtracted from the last run time (2 min)

parameters.name: consent.optin.values
parameters.description: Lower-case Eloqua values meaning CONSENT GIVEN, comma-separated, no spaces around commas

parameters.name: error.directory
parameters.description: Technical failures

parameters.name: eloqua.password
parameters.description: Eloqua API user password

parameters.name: dynamics.contact.phone.field1
parameters.description: First contact phone column to match on

parameters.name: dynamics.contact.phone.field2
parameters.description: Second contact phone column to match on

parameters.name: eloqua.base.url
parameters.description: Eloqua pod base URL (GET https://login.eloqua.com/id -> urls.base)
